thread.subject: Question about the invoice schedule for the Q4 retainer
thread.snippet: Before I approve the November invoice I need to confirm whether the second instalment moves to 15 December.

messages.subject: Question about the invoice schedule for the Q4 retainer
messages.text_body:
Hi team,

We received invoice AG-2026-0412 for the Q4 retainer and it looks correct, but the payment schedule in the statement shows the second instalment on 1 December. Our finance calendar had it on 15 December when we signed the renewal in September.

Could you confirm which date applies? If the schedule did change, I would like the revised dates in writing so we can close the purchase order.

Thanks,
Priya

messages.subject: Re: Question about the invoice schedule for the Q4 retainer
messages.text_body:
Hi Priya,

Thanks for catching this. The schedule was updated when the retainer moved to quarterly billing, and the 1 December date is correct under the current order form.

We can keep the 15 December date for this cycle as a one-off if that suits your finance calendar. I will confirm with billing before anything changes on your account.

Regards,
Agents team

messages.subject: Re: Question about the invoice schedule for the Q4 retainer
messages.text_body:
Hi again,

That works for us, thank you. Before I approve the November invoice I need one thing confirmed: will the second instalment be moved to 15 December in the system, or only for this cycle?

If it is only for this cycle, please send the December schedule so our accounts team can book it against the right quarter.

Priya

drafts.text_body:
Hi Priya,

The change applies to this cycle only. Billing will issue the revised December schedule by end of day Thursday 12 November, and I will copy you on it.

Regards,
Agents team
drafts.agent_notes: Drafted from the billing playbook. Confirm the Thursday date with billing before sending.
